description: The KV contract shared by the API (which writes these values) and the mobile Worker (which reads them). Both runtimes consume this file, so a field rename, a dropped key, or a changed canonical shape fails a test in one of them instead of drifting silently. The API suite asserts its serializer emits these shapes; the Worker suite asserts its handler interprets them.

canonicalRules: blockedSenders is always present, possibly empty
blockedSenders entries are distinct ignoring case, keeping the first spelling seen
blockedSenders is ordered by ordinal string comparison
unknown fields are ignored by the reader

__global_blocklist.description: Domains whose mail is dropped before forwarding.

suspended_users.description: User ids whose mail is dropped while suspended. Values are booleans.

rate_limited_users.description: User ids that exceeded the daily forwarding cap. Values are Unix seconds at which the limit lifts; a timestamp in the past no longer limits.
